title: Platform-ecosystem prior-art extract record
description: ONE mechanism, read from ONE platform's own corpus. The machine block and the human analysis live in a single `.md` file -- frontmatter plus body, never split and never deeply nested. Bounded on purpose: six top-level keys, one nesting level under `finding`, and no free-form maps. Enums are frozen-but-extensible and evolution is additive only.

item_id.description: The frozen queue row's canonical id, VERBATIM. The record's filename derives from it.

as_of.description: When the FACT was true, never when the file was written. `volatility` below is what makes this actionable rather than decorative.

skipped.description: Present iff `outcome: skipped`. A relevance bail STILL WRITES the record: a queue row that produced no file is indistinguishable from a spawn that never ran.

finding.description: Present iff `outcome: extracted`. ONE mechanism from ONE platform -- the unit a lens cuts across.

platform_id.description: The synthesis join key, minted by the wave-0 map. Every lens groups on it.

platform_type.description: The capability map's platform-type value, VERBATIM. The divergence lens partitions on it, so a paraphrase here makes a type-determined choice unreadable.

mechanism.description: The angle id this record answers.

version.description: A release, or the date the page itself states. `retrieved-only` is an EXPLICIT, distinguishable value for a page whose date is absent, implausible or self-contradicting -- three pages on this corpus are each one of those, and papering over that silently is the failure this value prevents.

authority.description: Ranking and dedupe input ONLY, never a cut. Convergence requires at least two `first-party-normative` records agreeing independently.

volatility.description: Which records rot first. `contractual` has a half-life of months; `historical` never rots. Without it every record looks equally fresh and a report inherits stale contractual numbers in silence.

statement.description: What the platform prescribes, in its own terms.

evidence_quote.description: A short VERBATIM quote -- the receipt. Structural, so a record cannot assert a revenue-share percentage without carrying the sentence it came from.

enumeration_count.description: An integer on an enumerating record and null elsewhere. The surface-size lens computes on it, and prose cannot carry a number a lens divides by.

announced_on.description: a4 only, nullable. The migration-debt lens divides by `enforced_on - announced_on`; an earlier revision named two fields the record did not carry, so three layers rested on data nothing produced.

basis.description: The classification value this rests on, named.

reversibility.description: What gives the build-order lens a formula instead of a vibe. It is a JUDGEMENT: the gate checks presence and membership only, and whether the judgement is right is a reviewer's condition.

vocabulary_refs.description: Externally-owned identifiers only -- a scheme name and its term. Nothing minted here.

notes.description: Cross-angle leads that are NOT this record's finding.
